outcome: Platelet Annexin V- and CD62 (P-Selectin) surface expression
cohort: The study included 16 patients with preeclampsia (6 severe, 10 non-severe), 32 healthy pregnant controls, 16 non-pregnant controls, and 6 patients with isolated gestational hypertension.
finding: Platelet mitochondrial membrane potential (Mmp-Index) was significantly reduced in patients with preeclampsia, especially in severe cases, compared to healthy pregnant controls, and normalized within days after delivery.
